_comment: Human-maintained gate for AIM → Pilot/Controller Glossary term links (plan §12.2/§12.3; rules in far_aim/links/glossary.py). Terms are verbatim PCG entry text. deny: never link this entry. allow_words: link this single-word defined entry case-insensitively. allow_acronyms: link this single-word defined entry only in capitals. Every entry needs a reason; an entry naming a term the accepted PCG edition lacks fails the build.

deny.reason: The AIM's own name appears in every note; the PCG entry only points back at the manual.
Every '14 CFR' citation would link the glossary's 'Code of Federal Regulations' entry; citations already link the regulation itself.
In the AIM capital 'CAT' is an approach category (CAT II/III); the glossary CAT is clear-air turbulence.
